first_public_run.head: 8c891f9aa35b9f97874e62445c63467bd7172700
first_public_run.failure_stage: terminal promotion meta-assertion after all frozen cases had executed

root_cause: v1 terminal code required every value in the promotion record to be True, but latency_participates_in_promotion is intentionally and prospectively False. The harness therefore rejected its own correct negative metadata flag after all substantive criteria were True.
correction: v2 preserves every v1 case constructor and frozen expected outcome, checks the ten substantive promotion criteria for True, and separately preserves latency_participates_in_promotion=false as non-promotional metadata.
interpretation: This is an implementation-hygiene correction, not an experimental result repair. The first run is preserved and must not be relabeled a scientific failure or discarded.
